Product Catalog

Default catalogLowe’s

New projects and Quick Orders use this catalog. Projects and orders you have already created keep the catalog they were made with.

Independent app. Brand names are used for identification only, with no affiliation or endorsement.

Paint Reps

Optional. Save a rep for each catalog you buy from, since a rep can only sell their own brand. A walk or order uses the rep for the catalog it was made with. Messages open in your own messaging app and are only sent when you tap Send there.

Customer Ready Text

For paint associates. When you tap COMPLETED on an order, the app can offer a "ready for pickup" text to the customer. The text gives the order number, the job address or label (shortened if it is long), and a short count of the containers, such as 9 x 5-gal, 1 x 1-gal. It never includes colors or prices. It only appears when no paint rep is saved above and the order has a phone number. Nothing is sent until you tap Send in your messaging app.

Friendly Maintenance Reminder

It's been about 30 days since your last backup.

Recommended: Create a complete business backup. This is a friendly maintenance reminder and will never block your work.

Customer Quote Setup

Your business profile, logo, and price book for PDF quotes. Saved only on this device.

Business Profile

Printed at the top of your Customer Quote PDF. It is stored only on this device. Only the business name is required.

Scope of work

The prep and protection you do on most jobs. Each line becomes a tick box on a quote and prints under Scope of Work, so the customer knows what is included. These are starting lines: edit them to match the work you really do. One item per line, up to 12.

Payment and customer replies

The app never takes a payment. Whatever you type here is printed on the quote, and the customer pays you however you normally get paid.

Adds Accept, Question or changes, and Decline buttons to the PDF. A button opens the customer's own text or email app with a message already written to the phone number or email above. Nothing goes through this app, and the app cannot see the reply.

Sales tax

Optional. A percent you set, added to quotes, change orders and invoices. The app only calculates it. It is not tax advice, and the rules differ by state and by what you sell.

Charge tax on

Invoices and reminders

These settings drive the due dates and the alerts on your Home screen.

The logo is resized on this device and saved with a white background. Tap Choose File to pick an image.

Price Book

Your own shelf prices by catalog, product, container and sheen. Enter the lowest sheen as the base price; each higher sheen is estimated by adding the sheen step, and you can type an exact price for any sheen. Prices you type on a quote are saved here and reused. Nothing here is sent anywhere.

Labor Rates

How fast your crew works. For a quote you can choose Labor: Hours from my rates. The app takes the measurements and coats on the walk, divides by your rates, and gives you an hours estimate you can change. Nothing is filled in until you enter it, and every number here is yours.

Line Items

Things you charge for often, such as a repair, prep or a fee. In a quote or change order, pick one from Saved line items to fill a line in one tap. The prices start empty: enter yours once and they are filled in every time. Change, delete or add your own. Everything here is yours, and is saved only on this device.

Add your own

Money Hub

Quotes, invoices, what is owed, your pipeline, exports and quote setup. Stored only on this device.

The app cannot see payments or replies. The numbers come from what you record on each quote, invoice and change order.

The pipeline report is part of a subscription.

Bookkeeper CSV lists every quote, invoice, payment and change order, with the lead source and job stage.

QuickBooks makes a Customers file, an Invoices file and a Payments list that you import into QuickBooks Online yourself.

Phone calendar adds the due date of every unpaid invoice to your calendar.

Legal & Disclaimers

Paint Project Manager V3.9 · Rev BR

Estimate Use

Paint Project Manager is an estimating and workflow aid. Calculations, coverage, quantities, product selections, pricing, availability, measurements, job conditions, and order details must be reviewed before use. The app does not replace field verification, product instructions, store procedures, or professional judgment.

Local Data & Privacy

Project records are stored on this device. Protect access to the device and exported backup files. Export data before changing devices or clearing browser storage. Do not enter information that is unnecessary for the estimate or order workflow. Messages to a paint rep or to a customer are created on your device and are sent only when you review them and send them yourself from your own messaging app. Your Business Profile, logo, Price Book, and Customer Quotes are stored only on this device and in backup files you export. A quote PDF is created on your device and leaves it only when you share or save it yourself. Reply links in a quote PDF open the reader's own text or email app with a message already written; this app does not send or receive that message. Invoices, change orders, signatures, photos, production rates, and payment records you enter are stored only on this device and in backup files you export. QuickBooks files and phone-calendar files are created on your device and leave it only when you share or save them yourself. Report a Problem writes a message on your device containing the app version, the kind of phone and browser, the screen you were on, the number of saved projects, and what you type. It leaves your device only when you send it yourself, and never contains customer or job details.

No Purchase Processing

The app supports estimating, shopping-list, mixing, staging, and reorder workflows. It does not complete payment, purchasing, delivery, warranty, or customer-contract functions. It does not contact any retailer, paint rep, or customer on its own. Customer quotes, invoices, change orders and work orders are documents you create and send yourself. The app does not take payments, send messages to your customers on its own (a reminder button only opens your own messaging app with a message you read and send yourself), or give tax, legal or accounting advice. Sales tax is a percentage you set; the app only calculates it. Payment instructions or links printed on a quote are typed by you; the app does not take, process, or see any payment. A customer's reply to a quote is a written message, not a signature, and it is not received by this app. A signature captured on this device is a record of the customer's agreement kept on this device. It is not a certified electronic-signature service, so have your contract wording reviewed.

Independent Application & Trademarks

Paint Project Manager is an independent product. It is not sponsored by, endorsed by, approved by, affiliated with, associated with, or connected to any retailer, paint manufacturer, supplier, or brand referenced in the app, including but not limited to Lowe's, The Home Depot, Sherwin-Williams, Benjamin Moore, and their respective affiliates, subsidiaries, and product lines.

All trademarks, registered trademarks, service marks, trade names, brand names, product names, product-line and series names, and logos referenced in this app are the property of their respective owners. They appear only as plain text, solely to identify the products and retailers they refer to, and for no other purpose. Their use does not imply any sponsorship, endorsement, partnership, or relationship, and no rights in any such mark are claimed.

Product lists, sheens, container sizes, and availability are provided for convenience and planning only. They may be incomplete, out of date, or different from what a retailer actually carries. Always confirm products, sizes, colors, and pricing with your supplier before ordering. The app does not supply prices or purchasing guarantees from any retailer or manufacturer. Every price in a Customer Quote is a price you entered yourself, and the quote is your own quote to your customer, not an offer from any retailer, manufacturer, or paint rep.
